description: Starts the game (built first unless build:false) in headless Chromium inside the autotest harness so you can play it yourself, e.g. to check gameplay the automatic gamealia_run_autotest cannot judge. Returns a session id plus the first screenshot. Then call gamealia_playtest_act with one action at a time (click x,y | key | drag | wait) and end with gamealia_playtest_stop for the verdict. Up to 40 actions per session and 2 sessions at once; idle sessions close after a few minutes. Local, no login.

build.description: Run the build command first when the project has one (default true)

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

profile.description: desktop: 1280x720 with mouse (default); mobile: 390x844 with touch, clicks become taps

name: gamealia_playtest
title: Start a playtest (you play)
